about.text: Our Story of Elegance
For over a decade, we've been transforming houses into homes with curated luxury décor that tells your unique story
From a Dream to a Legacy

Founded in 2010 by interior designer Isabella Moreau, {brand} began as a small boutique in Paris' Le Marais district. Isabella's vision was simple yet profound: to create a space where timeless design meets modern living, where every piece tells a story of craftsmanship and beauty.

What started as a curated collection of European antiques has evolved into a global luxury brand, but our core philosophy remains unchanged. We believe that your home should be a reflection of your journey, your taste, and your aspirations. Each piece in our collection is selected for its ability to transform spaces into sanctuaries of comfort and elegance.
Today, with flagship stores in Paris, New York, and Tokyo, and a dedicated online presence, we continue to serve discerning clients worldwide who appreciate the art of beautiful living.
Years of Excellence
Happy Clients
Countries Served
Our Core Values
The principles that guide every decision we make and every piece we curate
Exceptional Craftsmanship
We partner with master artisans and select manufacturers who share our commitment to quality. Every piece undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure it meets our exacting standards of excellence.
Sustainable Luxury
True luxury respects our planet. We prioritize sustainable materials, ethical sourcing, and production methods that minimize environmental impact while delivering exceptional beauty and quality.
Personalized Service
Your vision deserves our full attention. Our design consultants provide personalized guidance to help you create spaces that truly reflect your personality and lifestyle aspirations.
Timeless Design
We eschew fleeting trends in favor of enduring style. Our collections feature designs that will remain beautiful and relevant for years to come, becoming cherished pieces in your home's story.
Community Commitment
We believe in giving back. A portion of every purchase supports arts education programs and initiatives that promote sustainable design practices in communities worldwide.
Continuous Innovation
While honoring tradition, we embrace innovation. We continuously explore new materials, techniques, and design approaches to bring you fresh perspectives on luxury living.
Meet Our Founders
The visionary minds behind {brand}'s enduring legacy of beauty and craftsmanship
Isabella Moreau
Founder & Creative Director
With degrees from Parsons and École Boulle, Isabella brings 20 years of design expertise. Her Parisian upbringing instilled a deep appreciation for artisanal craftsmanship and timeless aesthetics.
Alexandre Dubois
Co-Founder & CEO
Formerly of LVMH, Alexandre brings strategic vision and operational excellence. His passion for sustainable business practices ensures {brand}'s growth aligns with our environmental commitments.
Sophie Chen
Head of Product Curation
With a background in art history and global sourcing, Sophie travels the world discovering exceptional artisans and unique pieces that embody the {brand} aesthetic.
Marcus Rivera
Director of Sustainability
Marcus ensures every aspect of our operations aligns with environmental stewardship. He leads our initiatives in sustainable sourcing and carbon-neutral logistics.
Our Mission

To enrich lives by creating beautiful, meaningful spaces that inspire connection, comfort, and joy. We believe that exceptional design should be accessible, sustainable, and deeply personal—transforming houses into homes that tell your unique story.

Every piece we curate, every space we help design, is part of our commitment to elevating the art of living. We're not just selling home décor; we're helping you create the backdrop for life's most precious moments.
Our Commitment to Sustainability
At {brand}, we believe true luxury must be responsible. Our commitment to sustainability is woven into every aspect of our business, from sourcing to shipping.

We partner with artisans and manufacturers who share our values, prioritizing renewable materials, fair labor practices, and production methods that minimize environmental impact. Our packaging is 100% recyclable, and we're working toward carbon-neutral operations by 2025.
Circular Design
Products designed for longevity and eventual repurposing
Ethical Partnerships
Fair wages and safe working conditions for all artisans
Renewable Materials
Prioritizing FSC-certified wood, organic textiles, and natural fibers
Carbon-Neutral Shipping
Offsetting emissions through verified environmental projects

Join thousands of discerning clients who have discovered the {brand} difference. Let us help you create a home that reflects your unique story and elevates your everyday living.

contact.text: We're here to help with any questions about our luxury home décor collections or your order
Our showroom at 123 Luxury Lane, Design District, NY

We offer a 30-day return policy for all full-priced items in original condition. Custom and personalized items are final sale. Returns must be initiated within 30 days of delivery, and items must be unused, in original packaging with all tags attached.

Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days within the continental US. Express shipping (2-3 business days) is available for an additional fee. International shipping times vary by location, typically 10-14 business days. You'll receive tracking information once your order ships.

Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination. Customs duties and taxes are the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in your order total. Please check your country's import regulations before ordering.

Absolutely! Our flagship showroom in New York's Design District is open Monday through Friday, 9AM-6PM EST, and Saturday 10AM-4PM EST. We recommend scheduling an appointment for personalized service, especially for large projects. Walk-ins are always welcome during business hours.
Do you offer design consultation services?

Yes, we offer complimentary 30-minute design consultations for purchases over $1,000. Our design experts can help you select pieces that work perfectly in your space. For comprehensive design services, we offer paid consultation packages starting at $250. Contact us to schedule a consultation.

product-details.text: This handcrafted ceramic vase showcases organic textures and minimalist design. Each piece is individually shaped and glazed by skilled artisans, resulting in a unique work of art for your home. The subtle earth tones complement any interior style, from modern minimalist to rustic chic.

This exquisite artisanal ceramic vase is the result of traditional craftsmanship meeting contemporary design. Each vase is carefully hand-thrown on a pottery wheel, allowing for subtle variations that make every piece unique.The glaze is formulated using natural minerals and applied in multiple layers to achieve depth and texture. The final product is fired at high temperatures to ensure durability and a beautiful matte finish.Features:Handcrafted by skilled artisansUnique organic textures and patternsFood-safe, lead-free glazeSuitable for fresh or dried flowersMade from high-quality stoneware clayIndividually signed by the artist
